title: Understanding Zero-One Loss
text: Consider how the zero-one loss function behaves. What happens to the loss when a prediction is correct versus when it is incorrect?

title: Gradient of Zero-One Loss
text: Think about how the zero-one loss changes with small changes in the prediction. Does the loss change smoothly or abruptly?

hintAnswer: The gradient is always $$0$$, so gradient descent never moves.
title: Behavior of the Gradient
text: Which of the following best describes the gradient of the zero-one loss function?
choices: The gradient is always $$0$$, so gradient descent never moves.
The gradient is positive for correct predictions and negative for incorrect ones.
The gradient is undefined for $$zero-one$$ loss.
The gradient is always positive, leading to divergence.
